product_info.title: Ola: Book Cab, Auto, Bike Taxi

reviews.snippet: I recently booked a ride with Ola for a destination approximately 9km away. However, due to a change in meeting location, I informed the driver to drop me off midway, after traveling only 1.9km. The driver complied, and I ended the ride. To my surprise, Ola charged me for the entire ride distance instead of the actual distance traveled. This is unacceptable. Furthermore, I've been trying to reach out to their customer support, but I'm not getting any response.

response.title: Ola (ANI TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED)
response.snippet: We understand this can be frustrating for you. In case you have any issues, kindly DM us your details via Twitter on our support handle @ola_supports, and we'll assist you right away.

reviews.snippet: Very bad App experience. The rating of the driver gets automatically 5 stars. No option to change it. Even after finding the ride below par, nothing can be done. No option in the rude help, especially to inform that the auto number shown is different from the auto arrived. No option to give our feedback about the ride. Charges are more than the other similar Apps. Drivers are not polite, unclean vehicles.

response.title: Ola (ANI TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED)
response.snippet: We are here to help you, Could you please connect with us via (m.me/olacabs) and share more about this, including your ride details, so that we can assist you accordingly.

reviews.snippet: I don't remember changing my payment option on the app. I have ended up paying both the driver and the Ola wallet dues! there's no support on this front too!! Edit: I realised the payment method changes when you use Ola Parcel. And later, when you try using the app for a ride, the payment option would have gotten updated. Such a petty bug. Uninstalling this rascaldom of an app until the fix!

I am extremely disappointed with the service. If riders are not willing to accept rides, I don’t understand why they are registering on the platform in the first place. I tried booking a ride multiple times, but the riders kept refusing or cancelling the requests. This was extremely inconvenient and resulted in me wasting several hours just trying to arrange a ride. The app should have a better system to ensure that riders who are actively available actually accept bookings.

Literally pathetic app. The driver claims to have accepted the ride and have picked me up, while in reality he is 10 minuted away. Even when I call him, he becomes unresponsive and doesn't pick up. He probably wants me to cancel the ride so he doesn't have to cancel it himself. It reduces my credibility and makes it harder for me to book. This has happened countless times. The drivers take advantage of this situation. Not to mention the sudden amount increase after accepting the ride.
